newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam's Jan industry output up yr-yr 12.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam's Jan industry output up yr-yr 12.9 pct.

text.p: Vietnam's General Statistics Office said on Wednesday it was expecting a year-on-year industrial growth rate of 12.9 percent for January.
Comparitive figures for January 1996 over the previous year's level were not available. Vietnam recorded a 14.1 percent industrial growth rate for 1996 as a whole.
The statistics office figures showed that state sector output rose by a year-on-year 10.5 percent, while non-state sector rose 10.4 and the foreign invested sector by 21.2 percent.
An accompanying report said growth in the oil and gas sector had been a prime contributory factor. Crude oil output was reported up 20.2 percent during the period.
Earlier the statistics office said Vietnam was expected to post a trade deficit of $420 million for January.
